import sys

def main():
    for line in sys.stdin:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        parts = line.strip().split()
        if len(parts) < 2:
            continue
        n, k = map(int, parts)
        p = list(map(float, sys.stdin.readline().strip().split()))
        sum_mask = [0.0] * (1 << n)
        for i in range(1 << n):
            for j in range(n):
                if i & (1 << j):
                    sum_mask[i] += p[j]
        count_nonzero = sum(1 for x in p if x > 1e-5)
        if count_nonzero <= k:
            result = [1.0 if x > 1e-5 else 0.0 for x in p]
            print(' '.join(map(str, result)))
            continue
        dp = [0.0] * (1 << n)
        dp[0] = 1.0
        for mask in range(1 << n):
            remaining_mask = (~mask) & ((1 << n) - 1)
            for i in range(n):
                if (remaining_mask & (1 << i)) and p[i] > 1e-5:
                    dp[mask | (1 << i)] += dp[mask] * p[i] / sum_mask[remaining_mask]
        answer = [0.0] * n
        for mask in range(1 << n):
            cnt = bin(mask).count('1')
            if cnt != k:
                continue
            for i in range(n):
                if mask & (1 << i):
                    answer[i] += dp[mask]
        print(' '.join(map(str, answer)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
